specs.label: Answer
specs.summary: Reply to the agent's open question with your text; the agent resumes from your answer.

specs.label: Continue
specs.summary: Let the agent resume without an answer, deciding the open question itself. Answer gives it your reply instead.

specs.label: Dismiss
specs.summary: Close the agent's open question without resuming it; the pull request goes back to whoever it waits on.

specs.label: Run now
specs.summary: Start the round waiting on this pull request now, without waiting for its delay or the daily budget. Skip drops it instead.

specs.label: Skip
specs.summary: Drop the round waiting on this pull request without running it. Run now starts it instead.

specs.label: Guide
specs.summary: Tell the agent what its round should look at; your text goes with the round waiting now, or with the next one when none waits.

specs.label: Trust folder and run
specs.summary: Trust the folder the agent was blocked on in your agent homes, then run the round. Dismiss block lifts the block without trusting it.

specs.label: Dismiss block
specs.summary: Lift the block without trusting the folder; the round waits for its next trigger. Trust folder and run trusts it and runs now.

specs.label: Start
specs.summary: Start new work from a brief: in a fresh worktree of a repository, or with no checkout

input.label: Guidance
input.placeholder: the brief: what to build or say, and how to know it is done

specs.label: Review
specs.summary: Start or continue a review round on someone else's pull request, in a dedicated workspace

input.label: Guidance
input.placeholder: what the round should look at

specs.label: Address
specs.summary: Triage the reviews and failing checks of a pull request you develop, in its workspace, changing its code where they call for it; Act only settles open items and drafts replies

input.label: Guidance
input.placeholder: what the round should look at

specs.label: Act
specs.summary: Act on the open items of a unit without touching its code: settle what you can and propose the replies it needs as drafts for you to approve; Address works on the code of a pull request you develop

input.label: Guidance
input.placeholder: what to do about the items

specs.label: Nudge
specs.summary: Ask whoever the pull request waits on for the next step, in a comment; guidance is the topic

specs.label: Take over
specs.summary: Make someone else's pull request yours to develop: from then on it counts as one of yours, and Address works on it.

specs.label: Pause
specs.summary: Stop automatic rounds on this pull request until you resume it, and drop the one waiting; it stays in your lists. Mute hides it instead.

specs.label: Resume
specs.summary: Let automatic rounds run on this pull request again.

specs.label: Mute
specs.summary: Take this pull request out of the lists that wait on you, for a while or until who it waits on changes; review and address rounds still run, unannounced, and no nudge goes out automatically. Pause stops the rounds instead.

specs.label: Unmute
specs.summary: Bring this pull request back into the lists that wait on you.

specs.label: Track
specs.summary: Follow this pull request like one in scope, though no other reason brings it in.

specs.label: Untrack
specs.summary: Stop following this pull request because you tracked it; another reason may still keep it.

specs.label: Open
specs.summary: Open the pull request's workspace in its workspace manager, or the pull request itself when it has none.

specs.label: Remove
specs.summary: Delete this pull request's workspace when nothing in it would be lost. Force remove deletes it whatever it holds.

specs.label: Force remove
specs.summary: Delete this pull request's workspace though a remove was refused; what it holds is lost for good.

specs.label: Refresh brief
specs.summary: Make this pull request's brief again now, from what it holds today.

specs.label: Start without brief
specs.summary: Start the turn this intake waits on now, without waiting for the brief. Cancel drops the intake instead.

specs.label: Cancel
specs.summary: Drop this intake: the turn it waits on never starts.

specs.label: Edit
specs.summary: Change the draft's text; it waits for your approval again.

specs.label: Retry
specs.summary: Send this draft again after its post failed.

specs.label: Open workspace
specs.summary: Bring the run's workspace on screen in the workspace manager it ran in.

specs.label: Enter session
specs.summary: Bring the run's agent session on screen to type in it; a session with no live process is woken first.

specs.label: Transcript
specs.summary: Read what the person typed and what the agent answered in the run's session.

plan.label: Apply
plan.summary: Run this plan item now, with the same guards as the sweep. Dismiss drops it instead.

plan.label: Dismiss
plan.summary: Drop this plan item for good; it does not run.

plan.label: Guide
plan.summary: Tell the agent what its round should look at; your text goes with the round waiting now, or with the next one when none waits.

input.label: Guidance
input.placeholder: what the round should look at

plan.label: Trust folder and run
plan.summary: Trust the folder the agent was blocked on in your agent homes, then run the round. Dismiss block lifts the block without trusting it.

plan.label: Dismiss block
plan.summary: Lift the block without trusting the folder; the round waits for its next trigger. Trust folder and run trusts it and runs now.
